title: Kroenke Sports & Entertainment to acquire Los Angeles Angels from Moreno family
dek: Stan Kroenke's holding company has announced a definitive agreement to purchase a controlling interest in the Los Angeles Angels, with the transaction expected to close in Q1 2027. The deal marks Kroenke's entry into Major League Baseball and ends Arte Moreno's 20-year ownership, during which the Angels have not made the postseason in 11 consecutive years.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Kroenke Sports & Entertainment announced a definitive agreement to acquire the Angels, pending closing in early 2027.
bottom_line: The closing is scheduled for Q1 2027. The first quarter of 2027 is when institutional conditions on the transaction are expected to resolve, and that date will confirm whether the deal advances to completion.
body: Kroenke Sports & Entertainment has announced a definitive agreement to acquire a controlling interest in the Los Angeles Angels Baseball Club from the Moreno family, marking Stan Kroenke's first move into Major League Baseball. The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions and approval.

The agreement ends Art Moreno's 20-year tenure as Angels owner. During his ownership, the Angels have not made the postseason in 11 consecutive years and will miss the playoffs again in 2026, per CBS Sports' reporting.

Kroenke Sports & Entertainment already operates franchises across six leagues and two continents, including the Los Angeles Rams (NFL), Denver Nuggets (NBA), Colorado Avalanche (NHL), and other properties. The Angels acquisition adds MLB to that portfolio.
Art Moreno and the Moreno family have not issued a statement regarding the sale in the available reporting.
